name: DocBlocks Documents
description: Create real documents from markdown — Word (DOCX), PowerPoint (PPTX), PDF, Excel (XLSX), EPUB, HTML, and MP4/GIF — via the DocBlocks MCP server. Artifact-first: conversions produce immutable session artifacts a gezel can inspect and preview page-by-page before saving the finished file into the project's artifacts drawer. Includes themes, slide templates, document validation, and PPTX layout inference.
